messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-48321 — embeddings-service high 5xx spike in us-west. Severity P2. Auto-page to oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-48321

alex: acked in PD, taking initial triage. pinging logs.

incidentbot: Auto-escalation schedule: if no status in 3m, escalates to secondary.

sana: seeing repeated timeout errors from embedder pods, sample error: "grpc: code = Unknown desc = backend: kvcache miss storm"

taylor: any customer impact yet?

customer_success: CS: two customers reported slow/failed uploads ~5m ago, they see 504/timeouts and retried 3x. No major outage reported by others yet.

ops_shift: taking ownership on channel, moving to bridge https://meet.example/bridge-48321 — will post status every 5m.

alex: running quick checks: ```kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide``` then ```kubectl logs -n prod -l app=embeddings --tail=200 | grep "kvcache"```

ops_shift: noticed several pods OOMKilled then restarted; current pod count 3 -> 1 temporarily. Scaling up to 4 replicas now.

sana: recommended rollback to model v1 (previous stable) if error rate doesn't drop in 6m. Preparing rollout job.

alex: applied horizontal scale + bumped CPU requests on embedder. Triggered healthcheck: `/internal/health` returning 500 intermittently.

incidentbot: PD update: alert suppressed for identical duplicates; incident annotated with initial responder alex.

ops_shift: mitigation step 1 done: scale applied at 1769554400, CPU requests increased. Watching traffic.

ops_shift: 1769554460 — metrics: 5xx rate down from 7.3% -> 2.1% (1m window). Still above baseline.

customer_success: notified affected customers of investigation and ETA ~15-30m.

sana: starting canary rollback of model to v1 on two pods (no config drift). If canary success, will roll remaining.

alex: logs show kvcache eviction storms correlating with long tail seq lengths from queued requests. Suggest prefix caching for heavy tails as long-term fix.

ops_shift: 1769554560 — rollback canary looks healthy, 5xx down to 0.9% on canary pods. Proceeding with full rollback now. Will update in 10m.

customer_success: thanks, please flag if we should escalate to SLA contact.

alex: adding follow-up ticket to infra backlog: investigate kvcache eviction patterns and autoscaler tuning.

sana: :thumbsup: good catch. After rollback we'll run load test with long-tail prompts to reproduce.

ops_shift: handing back to oncall rotation after rollback completes and metrics stable for 15m. Closing PD once we confirm customer signals.

incidentbot: PD note appended: mitigation steps recorded, owner=ops_shift, followups created.

alex: closing loop — I'll post postmortem draft once we have 1h of stable metrics.

sana: leaving final note: short-term mitigations: scale + rollback; long-term: kvcache resilience + smarter batching.
